description: MEHO reflex hooks — SessionStart injects a broadcast/memory/knowledge digest so read-before-start is automatic, and a one-time advisory reminder before the first call_operation says to read the feed and not to post (people read the feed; only agents post). Every hook is fail-open (missing meho CLI, no auth, no VPN, or timeout => silent no-op, exit 0) and warn-only: no hook blocks or denies a tool call.
